diagnosis.failure_mode: Policy loss is essentially zero throughout training (hovering around 1e-8 magnitude), indicating the policy network receives near-zero gradients and performs no meaningful updates. The approx_kl divergence remains exactly 0.0 and clipfrac remains 0.0, confirming that the PPO policy gradient updates are completely disabled. Despite the value function showing some learning (explained variance increases), the policy gradient appears to have a computational issue preventing backpropagation or an incorrectly implemented loss function that always evaluates to ~0. This causes the policy to remain random (entropy ~0.693) and unable to improve performance, resulting in flat episodic returns throughout training.
